meta.title: Elixir runtime helpers emitted as needed
meta.body_summary: Track Elixir runtime helper usage in the compiler and only emit _input, _count, and _avg when they are referenced, with updated README documentation.

perf_labels.notes: Small compiler change tracking Elixir helper usage to emit only needed helpers; merged within ~3 minutes without review.

review_details.performance_claim: Reduce final compiled code size by emitting Elixir helper functions only when they are actually referenced.

core_change_summary.description: In compile/ex/compiler.go, added tracking of which Elixir runtime helpers (_input, _count, _avg) are referenced during compilation, and only emit those helpers in the output. Added a new runtime.go file defining a map from helper name to usage boolean. Updated README to document helper emission behavior.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: README changes document the new on-demand emission feature.
change_trajectory: Single commit: track helper references, emit only used helpers, update README.

collaboration_trajectory: Author self-merged immediately after pushing the single commit; no human-bot interaction.
